scope: Local native published-sh execution and process-local WASI creation masks; not deployed.

upstream.binaryHandling: Downloaded, digest/size checked and installed through native software.install. No upstream binary or implementation source was committed.

baseline: The unchanged published package installed successfully but version, echo and for-loop executions all failed before entry: missing host_process.umask with three i32 parameters and an i32 result. Binary import inspection also identified optional terminal read/raw-mode imports absent from the linker.

implementation.umask: One u32 mask per native process, initialized to 0022. Brush read/set and libc setter ABIs return previous low nine bits, validate output memory before mutation and reject invalid read/set flags. The mask applies to regular creation, anonymous temporary files and directories, and does not add filesystem authority.
implementation.lifetime: Child gets an independent mask copy; exec preserves it. Actual R2 heap handover/restoration in a replacement workerd preserves the mask before subsequent creation operations.
implementation.terminal: No attached terminal exists in this backend. Raw-mode changes return WASI ENOTTY 59. Terminal reads trap explicitly instead of returning fabricated input, EOF or timeout. Existing WASI stdin behavior is unchanged.
implementation.contracts: The Rust mkdir request now carries its masked mode through the owning Effect Schema and native kernel publication boundary. No filesystem or process receipt persistence format change; opaque heap snapshots still require an exact Rust runtime digest.

validation.completeGate: bun run check passed: build, SDK declarations, TypeScript, workspace Clippy and Cargo tests; 338 native Bun tests, 57 files, 4335 assertions, 122.00 seconds.
validation.finalFocused: After strengthening read-only failure and terminal-outcome assertions: 2 native tests, 57 assertions, 10.11 seconds; final typecheck and formatting passed.
abiCases: bad output pointer rejected without mask mutation
file mode 0600 and directory mode 0700 under 0077
mode-zero file remains writable through its original descriptor
file 0666 and directory 0777 under zero mask
unavailable terminal read fails while retaining previously acknowledged stdout
validation.authority: Read/execute-only sh may modify its local mask but observes guest exit 1 on redirection, and the denied file does not exist.
validation.checkpoint: A real queued WASI program sets 0077, acknowledges output and parks during a 31-second sleep driven by native request-local TestClock. After terminating the original worker, replacement delivery resumes with checkpointCount 1; mask queries and real creation modes pass without repeating entry.
validation.smokeEightMiB: Additional isolated native probe passed version, echo, for loop and child/exec inheritance at guest memoryBytes 8388608. This is an enforced guest budget, not total Worker memory measurement.

exactArchive.transport: native Alchemy workerd service binding and Agent RPC; local R2 and Queue
exactArchive.proof: SDK archive exports and consumer declarations; runtime archive; filesystem snapshot restore; hard-link metadata; RPC callbacks and cooperative disposal; persistent driver contexts and cancellation; scoped authority

minutei.transport: native workerd Agent service binding; actual Minutei Code Mode and tenant SQLite; local R2, KV and Queue

limits: No deployment, remote native binding/model proof or publication in this change
Published sh requires explicit software installation; the built-in language:shell interpreter remains bounded
Not a complete Bash/POSIX conformance claim; default command bundle and additional published package coverage remain open
PTY remains unavailable; optional terminal calls fail explicitly
Same-build heap recovery was verified; heaps from another Rust runtime remain protected by the existing version/digest guard
No peak memory, production performance, cold-start or AgentOS cost advantage established
Minutei proof covers selected SDK 0.9.0 consumer fixtures only, with no history Queue consumer or authenticated/model/browser path
Exact archive behavioral/type checks passed; no new general secret scan or publication was performed
